# FG-DEPLOY-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`deploy`](../../ops/runbooks/deploy.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failed_health_check_on_prod_fails_without_rollback` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: デプロイの後のヘルスチェックが失敗しました。
- en: The health check after the deployment failed.
- id: Pemeriksaan kesehatan setelah deployment gagal.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 (ADR-0031 decision 8): after `<script> deploy <sha>` succeeded on every target, `<script> health <sha>` exited non-zero or passed its timeout on at least one. On an environment with `auto_rollback` (stg by default) the worker rolls every target back to the recorded previous version (`rolled_back` when that works); prod never rolls back by itself (`failed`): a person decides (runbook deploy).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.deploy.target_failed` (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `deployment_id`, `target`, `step=health`, `exit_code` or `reason=timeout`, then `forge.deploy.finished` with `status`. The script's output is not logged (it may carry secrets): read the application's own log on the target. Read: SELECT id, status, sha, previous_sha, error_code, failed_target FROM forge.deployments WHERE id = <deployment_id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the application and deploy a new SHA. On prod, follow runbook deploy (Failed health check) to decide between a manual rollback (request a deployment of `previous_sha`) and a forward fix.
